I did not open or cite its material in qa-r14-orphaned/; all evidence here is fresh. Every result comes from my own runs in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, removed at the end: two clones at the source commit ea9051b2, and one negative-control clone at aa0a68f1, the round-13 source. (1) In AR, getByRole('link', {name:'عملي'}) matched 2 links (strict mode: 'My Work' and the 'BAU and Improvement' entry also contains that word), so I made the name exact. (2) In EN, tab 1 followed the 'My Work' link and showed the signed-in My Work page, with no session-ended message (dev-run1-r14-03-en/test-failed-2.png). My Work is a static P2 page that makes no API request (apps/web/src/pages/AreaPages.tsx has no query), so the client cannot learn that the session ended until the next API call or the /me refetch after its 60 s staleTime. FE10 defines a session end as a 401 from a request, so this is expected behaviour, not an F-DG2-480 regression. I recorded it as an observation, not a finding: no data is exposed (the server refuses every request), and the next action that needs the API lands once on sign-in, which R14-01/R14-03 verify.
